action_items: Minor: Backend /api/admin/kyc counts could include all 4 keys defaulted to 0 to exactly match the review-request contract. Currently thinned to only >0 keys; FE handles gracefully but contract-level fix would be cleaner.
critical_code_review_comments: api.js adapter does getCache.clear() on ANY non-GET; this is coarse but intentional. Note: for a logged-in multi-tab scenario, a write in tab A will not invalidate the in-memory cache of tab B (no cross-tab signal). Not blocking but worth adding a BroadcastChannel in future.

api.js adapter mutates response objects shallow-cloning via spread; if any caller mutates res.data it will corrupt the cached entry. Low likelihood but a deep-copy or Object.freeze on cache set would be safer.
